_about: Haier HWD140-BD14LCGNU1 twin washer + dryer (class 0504), captured over the LAN by the integration's own diagnostics on 2026-10-28 while the dryer ran Ai Dry and the washer sat idle after a finished cycle. reported_values_now is Haier's cloud shadow read at the same moment. No device id, key, MAC or address is in here: the frames' uSS header carries none, and the typeid is the model's, shared by every unit of it.
